description: Interface describing an entry for the stream.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the entry was created. json-ld namespace:sch

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the entry was modified. json-ld namespace:sch

dateDeleted.description: The date/time of when the entry was deleted, as we never actually remove items. json-ld namespace:sch

userIdentity.description: The identity of the user which added the entry to the stream. json-ld namespace:twin-common

entryObject.description: The object to associate with the entry as JSON-LD. json-ld type:json

index.description: The index of the entry in the stream. json-ld type:sch:Integer

proofId.description: The id of the immutable proof. json-ld type:sch:identifier

verification.description: The verification of the entry. json-ld id
